notes.title: About application freeing
notes.notes:
To Our Dear Members,

I am sorry for my poor English.

A lot of requests have been received via e - mail that I want applications to be free.
Please check that distribution of the free version has started on the Windows store.

[url=https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9PD61SZT52D7]https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9PD61SZT52D7[/url]

In addition, I am sorry but the OS is Windows 10 only.
